purpose: Keep track of what I promised in meetings and what my reports owe me.

steps.title: Tasks
steps.adds: Your own tasks replace the sample.
steps.say: Bring my own tasks into my board

steps.title: Calendar
steps.adds: Your meetings appear at the top of the page.
steps.say: Connect my calendar to my board
steps.where: First switch on Google Calendar in the Claude app: Customize, then Connectors.

steps.title: Hourly job
steps.adds: The board keeps itself up to date.
steps.say: Start the hourly job for my board

steps.title: Meeting notes
steps.adds: What you promise in a meeting becomes a task.
steps.say: Add my meeting notes to my board
steps.where: For notes that arrive by mail, first switch on Gmail in the Claude app: Customize, then Connectors.

steps.title: Mail
steps.adds: Requests and promises in your mail become cards.
steps.say: Add my mail to my board
steps.where: First switch on Gmail in the Claude app: Customize, then Connectors.

steps.title: Chat
steps.adds: The same for the conversations you choose.
steps.say: Add my chat to my board
steps.where: First switch on Slack in the Claude app: Customize, then Connectors.

steps.title: People
steps.adds: Drafts follow the rule you set for each person.
steps.question: Who do you report to, who reports to you, and who do you meet every week? Names, roles, and any rule for writing to them.
steps.usual: The usual: no special rules; Claude writes to everyone the same way.

steps.title: Work areas
steps.adds: Tasks are grouped the way you see your work.
steps.question: Which three to six areas does your work fall into?

steps.title: Limits
steps.adds: What Claude may never do without your yes.
steps.question: Is anything else off limits?
steps.usual: The usual list: send, post, publish, create a ticket, send an invite, change a task's status.

steps.title: Preferences
steps.adds: Language, how Claude answers you, working hours.
steps.question: Which language, how should Claude answer you, and when should the hourly job run?
steps.usual: The usual: English, the bottom line first, every hour from 08:45 to 18:45 on weekdays.
